_what: T-127 — one case table for the ONE rule that decides whether an order reaches the depth its scope matches at.
_why: The rule has two readers in two packages: the API's `utils/geoMatch.validateScope` (which refuses the write)
and the user app's `utils/scopeCompleteness.scopeProblems` (which stops the form before the round trip).
There is no shared package between them — the apps were deliberately split out of the monorepo — so the
rule is written twice, which is the exact shape that bit T-123 and T-116: two readers of one rule drifting
apart silently. This file is what holds them together. Both suites run every case below through their own
reader and must produce the same problems.
It is READ AT TEST TIME ONLY. Nothing imports it at runtime, so neither app bundles anything from outside
its own tree and both stay standalone in the sense that matters. CI checks out the whole repo and only
changes `working-directory`, so a repo-root path resolves there exactly as it does locally.
_geo: Farg'ona viloyat(1): Farg'ona sh.(10) w/ QFY 100,101 · Marg'ilon(11) w/ QFY 110. Toshkent(2): Yunusobod(20) w/ QFY 200.
_shape: from/to are [province_id, city_id, settlement_id]; `problems` is the complete set, order-insensitive.
